title: RobustSec: feasibility-aware robustness evaluation of tabular intrusion detectors
description: RobustSec is a Python package for evaluating the adversarial robustness of tabular network intrusion detection systems (NIDS). It compares an unconstrained threat model with a feasibility-aware threat model declared in a feature schema, and provides FGSM, PGD, Carlini-Wagner, label-only and transfer attacks, PGD adversarial training, robustness metrics with Wilson confidence intervals, and a reproducible JSON-driven benchmark runner with NSL-KDD reference results.
